configuration.gepa_metric: score 0|1 + feedback naming expected squad + charter reminder

controls.cost_estimate: cost_usd_est is APPROXIMATE from summed held-out eval token usage at 0.15/1M input + 0.6/1M output USD; live-call truth is cache misses; compile-phase tokens NOT captured
controls.optimizers_see: train (and dev where the API requires validation) only

note_repeats_are_replicas: temperature 0; the 2 repeats per arm are replicas that re-run the full optimize+score loop with a cleared cache each time
